subject: Updates and missing attachment
text: I hope your morning is going okay. Sorry I forgot the attachment again. The budget sheet is not ready to share. I will send it by six, once I tidy the columns. On my side, the survey draft has grown too long, so I cut the questions about tool storage. That made the layout cleaner. I also asked the corner shop about donating bags, and she said she needs to ask her manager. We should probably stop assuming yeses. The meeting notes from Tuesday are now uploaded to the shared folder. Please check the dates before you print them. I noticed we listed the mulch delivery for Friday, but the vendor email says Saturday morning. I am not sure which one you agreed to. I can call them at noon if you are busy. I also moved the tool cart behind the shed. One wheel is wobbling, so please bring the wrench. I wrote the cost on a note, but I might misread it. If it seems odd, we can compare quotes before deciding this evening. Otherwise, things are moving. The new sign mockup looked too small when I held it up near the fence, so I asked for larger type. The paint samples arrived late, but they are pretty, especially the pale green. It will clash with the gate, but maybe that is fun. I will add the fence photos once my phone charges. Talk soon.
